682:t_2:109.en:
$$ノノ$$
「So $$ノノ$$ had decided to forget about $$ノノリリ$$ and just go on living...」

682:t_2:110.en:
$$ラルク$$
「That's a lie! You were always giving it everything you had! With hard work and guts!」

682:t_2:111.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Unlike me, who despaired when you left me behind, you kept moving forward!」

682:t_2:112.en:
$$ラルク$$
「That's why I... you were so dazzling to me...」

682:t_2:113.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But you kept on fighting, Big Sis... Without ever running away, with hard work and guts...」

682:t_2:114.en:
$$ノノ$$
「So after all, you are $$ノノリリ$$, Big Sis... You're my idol.」

682:t_2:116.en:
$$ノノ$$
「...It's always like this, really... I guess $$ノノ$$ is hopeless after all...」

682:t_2:117.en:
$$ノノ$$
「No matter how great a power $$ノノ$$ gets her hands on, she's still just a flame... If a big wind comes, she wavers right away.」

682:t_2:118.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But if you were here with me, Big Sis...」

682:t_3:4.en:
$$ラルク$$
(Of course it is... Now that my $$トップレス$$ ability is gone, $$ディスヌフ$$ has no power source anymore...)

682:t_3:5.en:
$$ラルク$$
(Everyone must be fighting right about now...)

682:t_3:6.en:
$$ラルク$$
(Being alone... is lonely, $$ディスヌフ$$...)

682:t_3:7.en:
$$ラルク$$
(...But $$ノノ$$ is... fighting all alone... even though she's really scared...)

682:t_3:8.en:
$$ラルク$$
「$$ディスヌフ$$...! You... can still move...!?」

682:t_3:9.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You want to save $$ノノ$$ too... don't you...」

682:t_3:10.en:
$$ラルク$$
「...The story $$カシオ$$ told me a while back might be worth trying...」

682:t_3:11.en:
$$ラルク$$
「$$ディスヌフ$$'s sealed power... I'll... use it!」

682:t_4:4.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I'm sorry, Big Sis... $$ノノ$$ had no idea how you felt... not at all.」

682:t_4:5.en:
$$ラルク$$
「That's not true! I was just being selfish!」

682:t_4:6.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I... got jealous of your power, and I charged ahead on my own... I don't deserve to be called Big Sis by you...」

682:t_4:7.en:
$$ノノ$$
「That's not true! Big Sis is Big Sis, no matter what!」

682:t_4:9.en:
$$ノノ$$
「No, $$ラルク$$... $$ラルク$$ is $$ノノ$$'s friend forever, and Big Sis too.」

682:t_4:10.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I'm sorry! It's just too embarrassing, so I'll keep calling you Big Sis!」

682:t_4:11.en:
$$ノノ$$
「...But... it's time to say goodbye.」

682:t_4:13.en:
$$ノノ$$
「As long as you never give up, a wish will come true someday.」

682:t_4:14.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Even if $$ノノ$$ vanishes at the end of causality, people will someday be able to master even time itself.」

682:t_4:15.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You... wanted to become an ordinary girl... didn't you?」

682:t_4:16.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I thought that once the fighting was over, I could live like that.」

682:t_4:17.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Then come with me, to make that happen! With your power and mine, we'll end this war!」

682:t_4:18.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But $$ノノ$$... has to do something about this $$特異点$$ first...」

682:t_4:19.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「So you're just going to go off somewhere on your own like that?」

682:t_4:21.en:
$$カズミ$$
「So this is how 《$$ユング#keyword$$》 felt when she saw us off back then.」

682:t_4:22.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ユング・フロイト$$... The first president of the Galactic Federation, right?」

682:t_4:23.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「She really moved up in the world, huh, $$ユング#pilot$$...」

682:t_4:24.en:
$$ノノ$$
「There is something that $$大統領$$ $$ユング#pilot$$ prepared, believing that you, who vanished into the black hole, would come back someday.」

682:t_4:30.en:
$$カズミ$$
「A message to welcome us back... So huge, and so beautiful...」

682:t_4:31.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「But the last character is backwards...!」

682:t_4:32.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Looks like a mistake slipped in during the rush construction...」

682:t_4:33.en:
$$ノノ$$
「...One of $$ノノ$$'s duties was to welcome you back and activate that message.」

682:t_4:34.en:
$$ラルク$$
「So that's why you objected so strongly to crashing $$翠の地球$$ into it.」

682:t_4:35.en:
$$ノノ$$
「That's not the only reason. It was also for the many people who fought to protect Earth...」

682:t_4:36.en:
$$ノノ$$
「And for the people alive now who love that planet... That's why.」

682:t_4:38.en:
$$ノノ$$
「...It's strange. I made up my mind to set out when I saw that message, and yet my heart wavers...」

682:t_4:39.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Without you, Big Sis, $$ノノ$$ is really just like a small fire flickering in the wind.」

682:t_4:40.en:
$$カズミ$$
「You can go home, $$ノノ$$. Look at the exposed $$特異点$$ you carry.」

682:t_4:42.en:
$$カズミ$$
「The force that seeks to exist has suppressed the force that seeks to vanish.」

682:t_4:43.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You can go home! So you can really go home now, $$ノノ$$!」

682:t_4:45.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I understand now what $$ＡＧ$$ meant... That $$翠の地球$$ is a planet that has been waiting all this time for someone to come back.」

682:t_4:46.en:
$$カズミ$$
「The people who left for the Moon... the people who set out for even more distant space, even giving up their human form...」

682:t_4:47.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「The people who vanished along with the sea in the $$時空震動$$... the people who fought to protect Earth...」

682:t_4:48.en:
$$カズミ$$
「The feelings poured into that planet, which waited for someone for 12,000 long years, must not have wanted to see another goodbye...」

682:t_4:49.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$ can go home... right? It's really all right for me to go home?」

682:t_4:50.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Yeah... From now on, we'll be together forever, $$ノノ$$!」

682:t_4:51.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes, Big Sis...! We'll be together forever and ever from now on!」

682:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...I never imagined that you would show up here.」

682:t_10:5.en:
$$アサキム$$
「The time has come for both of us to fulfill our long-held wishes. The least I can do is say hello.」

682:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「True. ...Although I hadn't anticipated things turning out like this...」

682:t_10:7.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Then I'll be on my way... I'll be waiting for you all to arrive.」

682:t_10:8.en:
$$アサキム$$
「In their universe... the $$カオス・コスモス$$.」

682:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...The Cursed Wanderer... So the end of his journey is near at last...」

682:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Not that I have time to wallow in sentiment. It's finally time for our own showdown, too.」

682:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That being the case, I'll save the congratulations for our ace pilots until next time.」

682:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But $$Ｄトレーダー$$ stays open without a break! And of course, I haven't forgotten this, either!」

682:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Today too, full steam ahead... business, business!」

683:t_000:0.en:
$$ニア$$
「We've broken through the defense line of the $$宇宙怪獣$$!」

683:t_000:1.en:
$$リーロン$$
「Our losses are 35% of our total force! Every ship in $c is safe, but it's seriously bad!」

683:t_000:2.en:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「But the galactic center is right in front of us! We hold out here!」
